agent_context.content: I need to understand what would make you happy before I can help. Let me ask a few quick questions to get us moving.

I’m feeling kinda stressed and low-energy tonight. A short funny story (nothing dark) and maybe a feel-good song recommendation would help—something upbeat like 2000s pop or indie (I like Taylor Swift, The Killers, and Phoenix).

Great! I have what I need. You want a short, funny (non-dark) story plus an upbeat feel-good song recommendation in the vein of 2000s pop/indie—artists like Taylor Swift, The Killers, and Phoenix. This is straightforward and I can deliver both right now without needing to research anything. Let me create these for you.
